name: GroundWork
oneLiner: A local code map and source-grounding checks for coding agents
audience: Developers using coding agents on existing repositories
problem: Agents need precise code locations and source definitions before changing an unfamiliar repository.
proofPoints: The symbol command prints ranked matches with file locations and signatures (src/cli/commands/query.ts).
The duplicate gate reports duplicated implementations when the agent stops; strict mode can hold the stop (src/hooks/handlers/duplicate_gate.ts).
The grounding hook checks new calls against source definitions (src/hooks/handlers/grounding.ts).

features.name: Symbol lookup
features.description: Search symbols and inspect their definitions through the local index.

features.name: Reuse gate
features.description: Report duplicated implementations at agent stop; standard mode provides context and strict mode can hold the stop.

features.name: Call grounding
features.description: Check new calls against source definitions through the agent hook.

claims.text: GroundWork searches symbols through a local index and prints file locations and signatures.
The duplicate gate reports duplicated implementations at agent stop; standard mode provides context and strict mode can hold the stop.
The grounding hook checks new calls against source definitions.
GroundWork uses a local index; its runtime does not require a hosted service. Optional embedding setup downloads a model only with explicit consent.
